blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. When something on your computer looks strange, the IT team can help. You are not alone.

In My First IT Task, you learn the everyday English you need for IT. You talk to the help desk, or you join an online meeting. The words are simple and the steps are short.

Today you learn five useful words and you practise in short, natural sentences. Go slowly — one step at a time. You can do it!

items.q: Which offices does IT support?
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: What do you learn in "My First IT Task"?
options: How to open a new office
The everyday English you need for IT
items.why: "you learn the everyday English you need for IT."

items.q: How does the text say you should go?
options: Slowly, one step at a time
items.why: "Go slowly — one step at a time."

items.q: The text says "You are not alone." This suggests that…
options: you must fix every problem by yourself
you can ask the IT team for help
items.why: Inferência: "You are not alone" quer dizer que o time de IT está lá para ajudar você.

items.q: Why does the text say "You can do it!"?
options: To tell you to work faster
To make you feel confident about the task
To say the task is impossible
items.why: Inferência: a frase encoraja o aluno — o tom é positivo e simples.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James guiando você na sua primeira tarefa de IT. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! I'm James from IT. Today we do your first IT task together. It is easy. Just follow me, one step at a time.

First, log in with your name and your password. Good. Now open your email and send a test email to me. This is only a test, so a short message is fine. Perfect.

Next, save a file on the shared drive. Give the file a clear name, so people can find it later. When the file is saved, please confirm with a quick message.

Now share the folder with your team. Sharing is important, because your team needs the same files. And last, close the laptop safely. Do not just shut the lid — log out first, then close it.

Well done! You finish your first task today. Remember: small IT habits are good habits. If something looks strange, call me. I am always here to help. See you soon!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking?
items.why: "I'm James from IT."

items.q: What is the FIRST step James asks you to do?
options: Log in with your name and password
items.why: "First, log in with your name and your password."

items.q: How should you close the laptop?
options: Turn it off at the wall
Log out first, then close it
items.why: "log out first, then close it."

items.q: Why does James ask you to give the file a clear name?
options: So no one can open it
So people can find it later
items.why: Inferência: "Give the file a clear name, so people can find it later."

items.q: How would you best describe James's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ele fala com calma, encoraja ("It is easy", "Well done!") e oferece ajuda.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I'm ready for the next IT task." A task is…
options: a small job or thing to do
items.why: Task = tarefa, um trabalho ou coisa para fazer.

items.q: "There's a new setup on the help desk." A setup is…
options: a way something is arranged or configured
items.why: Setup = configuração, o modo como algo está montado.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "This is only a ___, so a short email is fine."
items.why: Test = teste; a frase fala de um e-mail de teste.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "When the file is saved, please ___ with a quick message."
items.why: Confirm = confirmar; você avisa que já salvou.

items.q: "You finish your first task today." To finish means to…
items.why: Finish = terminar, completar.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de IT e trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please log in with your name and password." To log in means to…
options: enter the system with your details
items.why: Log in = entrar no sistema com seus dados.

items.q: "Before you close the laptop, log out first." To log out means to…
items.why: Log out = sair do sistema com segurança.

items.q: "IT will set up your new laptop tomorrow." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = preparar e configurar algo para uso.

items.q: "Always back up your files on the shared drive." To back up means to…
options: save a copy in a safe place
email the files to a client
items.why: Back up = fazer uma cópia de segurança.

items.q: "When something looks strange, reach out to IT." To reach out means to…
items.why: Reach out = procurar alguém, pedir ajuda.
